title: Gaziantep & Kayseri Manufacturing Hubs: Planning Factory Visits
metaDescription: Planning a Gaziantep and Kayseri factory visit takes two focused days using direct 90-to-105-minute flights from Istanbul.
quickAnswer: Planning a Gaziantep and Kayseri factory visit takes two focused days using direct 90-to-105-minute flights from Istanbul. Gaziantep leads in machine-made carpets, processed food, and packaging, while Kayseri anchors upholstered furniture and bedding exports. Pairing a bilingual driver-coordinator with pre-vetted supplier schedules prevents wasted transit across sprawling industrial zones.
category: Business Travel, Trade Fairs & Corporate Delegations (ITO Advisory)

body.text: What export sectors (carpets, food processing, packaging, furniture) lead in Gaziantep and Kayseri?

Gaziantep dominates Türkiye's production of machine-made carpets, dry pasta, pulses, confectionery, textiles, and corrugated packaging across its multi-zone industrial parks. Kayseri specializes in upholstered sofas, mattresses, bed bases, and supporting foam, spring, and steel-frame supply chains, ranking fourth among Turkish provinces in furniture exports with USD 600 million shipped in 2025.

According to the [Gaziantep Chamber of Industry (GSO)](https://gso.org.tr/en/general-page/the-industry-of-gaziantep/industrial-zones-56.html), the province's core manufacturing lines span machine-made carpets, food processing, plastics, textiles, chemicals, and medical products. Corrugated cardboard and food-grade packaging plants sit directly beside food and textile exporters ([GSO Industrial Structure](https://gso.org.tr/en/general-page/the-industry-of-gaziantep/industrial-structure-53.html)), allowing international buyers to audit both product lines and export-ready cartons on a single trip. The [Gaziantep Organized Industrial Zone (GAOSB)](https://www.gaosb.org/) houses dozens of Türkiye's largest industrial exporters.

In Central Anatolia, the [Kayseri Organized Industrial Zone](https://www.kayseriosb.org/) concentrates roughly 440 furniture companies employing around 35,000 workers ([GLM Sofa Industry Report](https://glmsofa.com.tr/en/blog/why-kayseri-is-one-of-turkiyes-furniture-manufacturing-hubs)). Because frame, foam, spring, and upholstery fabric suppliers operate inside the same zone, international wholesale buyers can inspect mixed-container sofa and mattress orders directly with factory production teams rather than trading intermediaries ([Ellda Mobilya Buyer Guide](https://elldamobilya.com/en/guides/kayseri-furniture-manufacturers)).

body.text: How do flight schedules from Istanbul work for a 2-day factory trip?

Direct domestic flights from Istanbul Airport (IST) reach Gaziantep (GZT) in roughly 1 hour 45 minutes and Kayseri (ASR) in about 1 hour 30 minutes. Catching an early 06:30–07:30 departure lets buyers complete three factory audits on Day 1, hold follow-up pricing meetings on Day 2 morning, and return to Istanbul that evening.

[Turkish Airlines Istanbul–Gaziantep flights](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en/flights-from-istanbul-to-gaziantep) operate multiple times daily from IST and Sabiha Gökçen (SAW), averaging 1 hour 45 minutes in the air. Similarly, [Turkish Airlines Istanbul–Kayseri flights](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-tr/flights-from-istanbul-to-kayseri) take about 1 hour 30 minutes, keeping same-day and 48-hour sourcing loops practical. Because direct flights between GZT and ASR are limited, buyers visiting both hubs usually fly IST–GZT on Day 1, return via Istanbul or drive roughly 4.5 hours overland via Kahramanmaraş and Göksun, and depart from ASR on Day 2 evening.

items: Book early-morning IST departures (before 08:00) to arrive at the first industrial zone gate by 10:30.
Schedule no more than three factory visits per day, allowing 90 minutes per plant plus 25–40 minutes for gate security and transit.
Request written product specs, MOQ sheets, and ISO/BRC certificates before landing so plant floor time stays focused on quality control.
Confirm factory lunch hospitality ahead of time, since hosted midday meals often shift afternoon appointments by an hour.
Leave a 90-minute buffer before evening domestic check-in at GZT or ASR.

body.text: Why is a local bilingual driver-coordinator essential in industrial zones?

Industrial zones in Gaziantep and Kayseri span thousands of hectares of numbered avenues where street signage is minimal and English is rarely spoken at security gates. A dedicated bilingual driver-coordinator handles gate clearance, confirms live factory directions by phone, translates technical shop-floor discussions, and keeps tight multi-plant schedules moving on time.

Standard airport taxis rarely wait inside GAOSB or Kayseri OSB during two-hour audits, and using a supplier's car compromises independence when visiting competing plants. A dedicated private vehicle and bilingual coordinator protect confidentiality between quotes, store samples securely, and absorb schedule shifts.

Where do international buyers stay and dine?

International buyers typically stay in five-star business hotels along Şehitkamil in Gaziantep or central Kocasinan and Melikgazi in Kayseri, keeping airport and industrial-zone transfers under 30 minutes. Both cities offer strong regional dining, from Gaziantep's UNESCO-recognized pistachio and kebab kitchens to Kayseri's historic pastırma and mantı restaurants.

In Gaziantep, [Divan Gaziantep](https://www.divan.com.tr/hotel/divan-gaziantep-hotel) and [Tuğcan Hotel](https://www.tugcanhotel.com.tr/en/index.html) provide reliable high-speed Wi-Fi, quiet meeting lounges, and straightforward highway access toward GAOSB. For client dinners, central Gaziantep's traditional kebap houses around İmam Çağdaş offer private tables suited to post-audit hosting. In Kayseri, [Radisson Blu Hotel Kayseri](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/hotels/radisson-blu-kayseri) and [Wyndham Grand Kayseri](https://www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-grand/kayseri-turkiye/wyndham-grand-kayseri/overview) sit near Erkilet Airport (ASR) with conference rooms and direct Kayseri OSB access.

faq.q: How far is Gaziantep Organized Industrial Zone from Gaziantep Airport?
faq.a: GAOSB sits roughly 30 to 40 minutes by car from Gaziantep Oğuzeli Airport (GZT), depending on ring-road traffic and which numbered zone (1st through 5th OIZ) your supplier occupies.

faq.q: Can I visit both Gaziantep and Kayseri in a single two-day trip?
faq.a: Covering both cities in 48 hours is tight because overland driving takes about 4.5 hours. Most buyers dedicate two days to one hub or extend to three days when auditing factories in both provinces.

faq.q: Do factories in GAOSB and Kayseri OSB operate on Saturdays?
faq.a: Many production lines run half-days on Saturdays, though export sales directors and quality-assurance managers are best scheduled Monday through Friday between 08:30 and 17:30.

faq.q: Should I let a prospective supplier pick me up from the airport?
faq.a: Using a supplier's driver is convenient for a single-vendor relationship, but if you are auditing competing factories or negotiating pricing, an independent private vehicle keeps your itinerary confidential.

faq.q: What should I wear for factory audits in Gaziantep and Kayseri?
faq.a: Wear closed-toe, flat shoes and smart-casual attire. Food-processing plants in Gaziantep provide disposable hairnets, shoe covers, and lab coats at hygiene checkpoints.
